caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a blank, light beige background. The object resembles a thimble, rendered in shades of yellow and gold with brown and greenish detailing. The top of the thimble is rounded and dotted with small indentations. Below the rim, the thimble has a decorative band featuring an ornate floral and leaf-like motif with swirling lines, highlighted in darker brown and greenish hues. The base of the thimble is slightly flared and outlined with a thin, dark perimeter. The composition is simple, with the detailed object isolated against an otherwise empty background.
title: Gold Thimble
